name: BurnerMan's 0x37's spawn's r4, each game's leftover
why: BN4's third-kind spawn (0x080032F0 through 0x08003210) stores the caller's r4 at the object's +4, as BN6's twin through the dispatch's spawner does; BurnerMan's spawner of his third kind 0x37 (0x080D3FA8: push {r0,r1,r2,r5}; movs r0,#0x37; the spawn) sets r0 alone, and its caller, his own state (its bl at 0x080BDF40), leaves r4 as his state runner called the state: in BN4 his +0 byte as BN4's object runner read it (0x13, 0x08003166), in BN6 his AI data's address (BN6's state caller 0x0801B9E6). No code of the 0x37 object reads its +4 to +7 (its block 0x080D3EF0-0x080D4050 searched: no ldr, ldrh or ldrb of [r5,#4] to [r5,#7]), as ThunderMan's 0x70's
